caption: Down 54-38 at the half, the San Antonio Spurs stormed back behind Stephon Castle's 26 points and Victor Wembanyama's 25 and 16 to beat the Lakers 99-96 and knock Luka Dončić's team out of the NBA Cup.

beats.caption: The Los Angeles Lakers led the San Antonio Spurs 54-38 at halftime after a 27-14 first quarter.

beats.label: SPURS THIRD QUARTER
beats.caption: San Antonio outscored Los Angeles 30-14 in the third quarter, tying the game at 68 on a Keldon Johnson three.

beats.label: STEPHON CASTLE
beats.caption: Stephon Castle scored 26 points on 10-for-15 shooting, while Victor Wembanyama added 25 points and 16 rebounds.
The Spurs won the second half 61-42 and finished with a 99-96 victory over the Lakers.
Stephon Castle's three-pointer with 43.4 seconds left put San Antonio up 96-90 and the Lakers never recovered.
The win sends San Antonio into the NBA Cup knockout round, while Luka Dončić's 31 points were not enough for Los Angeles.

sources.claim: Final 99-96; Castle 26 pts (10-15 FG), Wembanyama 25 pts 16 reb, Dončić 31, Spurs trailed 54-38 at half, led 27-14 after Q1, won Q3 30-14 tying 68-68 on Keldon Johnson three, Castle three made it 96-90 with 43.4s left, advance to knockout round, Lakers eliminated
